chapter: Fisher's band and Jack Laine's bands
title: Pecan Grove, Gretna halls and other places he played
summary: Allen asks about Pecan Grove near the Harvey-Gretna ferry; Brunies lists halls in Gretna and elsewhere where he played with Fisher and Jack Laine.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I used to get up the next morning and go to work in the brook. Well, about where was that pecan grove? I've heard about it. I don't know. It's up there in Crescent Park. I know where the ferry was. Between Harvey and Gretna. Up in there. Is it right on the river? Right on the river, yes. Is there anything left there now? No. Nothing in all the Goplin's Hall.

And they used to have a Finan's Hall up there. I used to play in that too. I used to play in the fish's band. And the Crockett's Hall in Gretna. Jack Lane. And Owl's Hall. And the Owl's Hall. And uh... Tell them about the Emmett Hardy.
